prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1142; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the intersection area in Katy, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right-hand lane of the access road with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the right front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that while attempting to change lanes to the left, Vehicle 2 moved into the same lane and the two vehicles sideswiped one another. Driver 2 stated they did not see Vehicle 1 until contact occurred and that they had been checking their mirror before the lane change. A single Passenger was seated in the front right seat of Vehicle 1 and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back and was evaluated by EMS on scene; Driver 1 declined transport. Both vehicles were drivable and were moved from the travel lane. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Driver 2 was issued a citation for failure to maintain a single lane. Exchange of insurance information was completed.
